newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm on outside spec buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm on outside spec buying.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed firm on the presence of outside but small lot speculative buying, traders said.
"There was not a lot of news but a lot of outside spec orders were coming in. With the kind of volatility we've had it brings in new players," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 750 contracts, below the 1,517 traded Friday.
Rice futures closed unchanged to 2-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with March unchanged at $11.89.
